meta.name: Hum Tum and Them 720p
meta.description:
Shiva is divorced woman with a 13-year-old daughter, Jahaan. Yudi is a father with three children, Aaryan, Ojhas, and Vyoma, who lost his wife to cancer 5 years ago. Shiva is trying to enjoy her new life as an independent, single woman, but her problems just start when her daughter starts blaming her for the divorce. Yudi has enjoyed five years of bachelor life but now his children have re-entered his life and he must deal with their teenage problems. All this, while Shiva and Yudi find love again in each other, but their personal inhibitions as well as the children’s disapproval keep them from truly coming together.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 6 Dec 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 22 min
Studio: ALTBalaji, ZEE5 · Network: ZEE5, ALTBalaji

Complete series. On your server: S1 15/15

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Mother India Meets Absentee Father
videos.overview: Shiva is struggling to be the best mother to her teenage daughter. Yudi is struggling to shed the responsibility of his three children that he is thrust with. Shiva involuntarily goes on a solo vacation, she meets Yudi and pours her heart out to him

videos.title: Jee Le Zara
videos.overview: Shiva accepts Yudi’s invitation to spend time with him. But Shiva is distraught when Jahan goes missing.

videos.title: Love, Sex Aur Bachche
videos.overview: As Yudi spends more and more time with Shiva, he comes off as an increasingly irresponsible dad to Aryan. But he doesn’t do much to change either.

videos.title: Kids Problem Buffering, Love Suffering
videos.overview: Jahan and Shiva return from their vacation while Yudi’s children come to stay with him for three months.

videos.title: Bachchon Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: Shiva rejects Yudi’s plea to give them a second chance in her attempt to appease her daughter.

videos.title: Friend Zoning
videos.overview: The blame game continues between Shiva and Nikhil as he accuses her of forcing their daughter into a hostel.

videos.title: Kuch Iss Tarah
videos.overview: Jahan agrees to stay when Shiva and Nikhil come together as a family.

videos.title: Theher Jaa Dil
videos.overview: Now homeless Shiva moves in with Yudi for the time being. Nikhil accuses Shiva of breaking not only their family but even their home.

videos.title: Ki Karna...?
videos.overview: Shiva gradually becomes a part of Yudi’s household. But it makes him nervous and confused.

videos.title: Don't go Shiva!
videos.overview: Yudi realizes how much Shiva means to him when she decides to leave his house.

videos.title: Shiva 2.0 meets Yudi 2.0
videos.overview: Vyoma and Jahaan join hands to separate Yudi and Shiva. Vyoma hatches up a seemingly full proof plan.

videos.title: Heartbreak Hotel
videos.overview: Shiva breaks up with Yudi. The mother-daughter duo leaves Yudi’s home, leaving OJ battling with anxiety.

videos.title: A Second Chance
videos.overview: Shiva and Yudi confess their love to each other. Yudi throws a party to celebrate their union.

videos.title: Hum, Tum And Us?
videos.overview: Shiva considers Yudi’s past and feels being with him may not be such a good idea after all.

videos.title: Mehroom Dil
videos.overview: Everything comes crashing down as insecurities and fear take the better of everyone. Will Shiva and Yudi overcome their inhibitions and find love again?
